concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-test-node]] - Node.js `check` test notification triggered in the Control Panel, with only notification kind and UTC trigger time documented and no business-object payload established
warnings: Keep `check` scoped to a Control Panel-triggered test notification.
Do not treat the test as a transaction, payment, subscription or other real production event.
Preserve the documented payload boundary: only notification kind and UTC trigger time are listed; no business-object payload is established.
Keep sample-generation and broader test-delivery workflows with the separate testing guide.
